description: Publish the latest saved version of a publish-to-update page. With named reviewers, a non-reviewer asks them to publish (requested=true); a reviewer publishes directly. approve=true approves the pending request and publishes the version it names, not later drafts; only a reviewer may approve. Read publishing status with anyforge_get_page. Only call when the person asked to publish, request publication or approve.
name: anyforge_publish_page
title: Publish page
